protocol: Fresh camera-translation evaluation frozen after development diagnosis; independent reset per episode; no within-episode fault.
temporary_condition: Both table marker images are suppressed until simulation time 1.0 s (0.5 s after reset); object and gripper marker remain visible.
unavailable_condition: Both table marker images are suppressed for the whole episode; object and gripper marker remain visible.
tool_marker: Non-colliding simulated cyan marker rigidly attached 0.11 m from gripper body origin, with known position from nominal joint kinematics; idealized and not validated on hardware.
movement_limit_note: Movement budget is checked before each step and can overshoot by one bounded action.
gripper_detection_rule: Report and retain all episodes; an initial missing object or gripper marker is a visibility failure and makes the intended comparison ineligible.
